title: Mope.io V2 Migration Preparation
description: In preparation for the Mope.io V2 migration on 20 June, account-related functionality will be temporarily paused starting 19 June at approximately 09:00 UTC.
During this period, players may be unable to use login, registration, account settings, shop, coins, skins, and other account-based features.
Account data is not intended to be deleted as part of this process.
Further updates will be posted as the migration progresses and once account functionality is restored.

title: Fixes

description.title: Arena changes
description: Walls moves twice slower
Walls get minimum radius at the 4th minute, leaving 3 minutes until final timeout with small walls
If no one died at the timeout, both are killed
These changes fix the previous bugs introduced by arena changes
Fixed the coin status message (for real this time).

title: Small Fixes & Changes
description: Fixed arena ending in a bugged way.
Fixed the coin status message.
Removed the adblock check.

description.title: New shop features

Coins purchasing is back as well with a better interface
New gem currency to purchase premium skins
New exclusive skins

Part 2 is coming soon with more skins and features..

description.title: Fixes and balancing
description: Inputs not being handled should be fixed
Land Monster sink hole duration is reduced by 50%
Auto-arena limit for BDs is now 8
Dragons and phoenixes are no longer colliding with beehives under trees
Removed unfair arena closing burn
15M xp gain cap is now removed
Health now regens in KD/BD auto-arena
BD cannot hide in volcano if another BD is close
An 1v1 invitation is not valid anymore if one of the fighter is a BD/KD with low health
Animals can't collide in caves anymore (cant block each others)

title: Fixes
description: Fixed yet another ghost player issue.
Fixed session reconnects.

title: Fixes & Small Changes
description: Increased client movement speed back to 120 based on the feedback.
After landing from a Dino Monster throw, you gain 2.5s immunity to any abilities.
Re-enabled 5s invincibility on spawn.
Allowed logged out players to 1v1.

description.title: Changed arena settings to beta ones
description: Battle start interval: 25s->15s
Time for first shrink: 60s->10s
Time for next shrinks: 30s->15s

Fixed an issue where during the small window of time between server requesting the captcha response and receiving it, the player could disconnect and not be properly removed from the server causing more lags over time.

title: Movement speed increase
description: Increased movement speed to 110

title: Bug Fixes, Optimizations & Movement
description: Mope.io community we are working on bringing coins back! If everything goes according to plan you will be able to receive coins in the next month.
Added Stockholm and Brazil servers.
Improved account server hardware.
Increased networked angle precision (from ~1.411 degrees to ~0.005 degrees).
Added additional game server optimizations.
Changed client movement speed to 100 from 120.
Fixed a bug that caused a constant variable increase in latency.
Fixed an issue where shop animals would go into skins tab instead of features tab.
Disabled Christmas mode.

title: Beta Mope.io
description: Welcome to beta version of mope.io!
Just like before the servers here are unstable and may restart at any time.
Currently we are testing out the movement changes, so please make sure to send your feedback in the discord server!

Beta accounts aren't synchronized with the live mope accounts, so if you didn't login into your account before 18th of January, your account will be recreated from scratch on beta (live mope accounts are fine).

title: Christmas
description: Merry Christmas!
Claim a limited time skin - free Santa Dragon!
Mope world is temporarily freezing cold! Snowballs are now everywhere!
Special Christmas food is scattered around the map now!
One of the snowman variants will always appear!
Visual snowflakes that you can turn off in the options (permanently turned off on low graphics)
Fix: Mudspots that are created from abilties should show up correctly
Fix: Pumpkins should show up to everyone consistently now.

title: Bug Fixes & Optimizations
description: Another batch of server optimizations.
Small improvements to server networking code.
Should've fixed the server crash issues.
Should've fixed an issue with players accidentally having focus on an invisible ad (no keyboard input)
Fixed an issue with the player's bar type not being reset (no more lava drinking mouse)
Fixed Dino Monster and Giant Scorpion being invisible underwater.
Server physics are tick independent now, this means that something like 40 TPS will still feel close to 60 (smooth!)
Improved client rotation code to skip less frames, should be more smooth now.
Reverted fox ability behaviour (now should kick all animals below Rhino tier instead of only stunned animals inside holes).
Reduced the minimap pumpkins update time (now it updates every 1s)
Removed vertical rivers (currently they don't serve much purpose and take up a ton of server performance).
Removed expired LF servers from the list.
Fixed an issue with the shop animal increased rarity not working.
Fixed an issue where desert chipmunk spat food could've affected players inside arena.

title: Server Fixes
description: We have improved server collision performance by ~2.5x
Connection issues should be fixed as well.
Please report any gameplay bug caused by this update in our discord server.

title: Misc Updates.
description: NEW: End Screen. Now you can see your stats on death.
NEW: TPS and PING counter under the map. TPS measures Server FPS, while PING measures your connection quality to the server.
Increased map opacity for better readability.
Fixed filter not working on nicknames.
Working on improving the server performance.

title: New Servers
description: Temporarily added LF servers to the menu.

title: Server Fixes

Pumpkins now shouldn't dissapear when you hold them.
We are taking steps to improve server performance.

title: Fixes Part 1
description: We are excited to announce that Mope.io has been officially acquired by 3AM Experiences!
If you encounter any bugs please report them on the official discord server.
This update has fixed major bugs with the game while also changing the game's art to the one preferred by players.
Make sure to setup your skins in the new wardrobe page in the shop!
Next update will be focused on gameplay, suggestions are welcome!
We have added pumpkins to the map replacing the mopeballs.
Coin earning has been TEMPORARILY DISABLED to prepare for a shop price change.
Current server locations are not permanent and will change based on player's feedback.
Current server locations are not permanent and will change based on player's feedback.
